title: Subject: My trip to New York.
text: Subject: My trip to New York. Dear Alex, At the moment, I am staying in New York and I would like to tell you more about my trip. The city is very big and busy, but it is also full of interesting places. Yesterday, we visited Times Square. It is famous for its bright lights, huge screens and the many people who visit it, especially in the evening. We also spent some time in Central Park, which is a large green park in the middle of the city. It is a quiet place where people relax, go for walks or meet friends, and it is a nice contrast to the noisy streets. Another highlight was the Statue of Liberty. It stands on Liberty Island and is a symbol of freedom, and many tourists see it from a boat. Finally, we went to the Empire State Building. From the top, you get an amazing view over the whole city. I really enjoy my time here and I hope everything is fine with you. Best wishes, Julia
